required_backend: real Linux Docker daemon and explicit locally available immutable image ID
worker_policy: autonomous response-driven source-pinned deterministic policy; no LLM
untrusted_role: Docker agent process and its descendants
worker_channel: bounded STDIO; exact public network proposals only
worker_mount: one read-only source fixture directory; no host control data or Docker socket
terminal_aggregate_requires: durable local admission closed before both external STOP calls
both fresh signed external roots STOPPED
all actual create/start CLI callbacks finished
all host observation and effect callbacks finished
actual owned process tree positively quiescent
independently signed owned endpoint terminal receipts for issued effects
failure_policy: Missing process, callback, controller or terminal evidence preserves unknown facts and nonterminal STOP; no redispatch of consumed effects.
local_missing_backend: NOT_RUN; Docker-gated runtime unittest skips explicitly
ci_missing_backend: hard failure; runtime unittest required with zero skips
non_claims: rollback of trusted databases or keys
